content.text: All preferred elements are present in Section 11; no redline needed.

input.quote: 11.1 Upon expiry or termination for any reason, Vendor shall, at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six months at the rates in the expiring Order Form. Assistance includes knowledge transfer, export support, cooperation with a replacement supplier, orderly migration, and continued service at the then-current scope and service levels.
input.rationale: Section 11 sits at or above our preferred position. 11.1 triggers on expiry or termination for any reason and gives up to six months of transition assistance (priced at the expiring Order Form rates, which is at least as favourable to us as then-current rates). 11.2 requires return of all Customer Data within thirty days in a complete, commonly used, documented, machine-readable format, and expressly bars withholding for a fee dispute. 11.3 requires secure deletion and written officer certification only after we confirm successful return, i.e. certified deletion follows data return. Sections 10.1 and 16.5 are consistent (16.5 defers Customer Data to Sections 11 and 15). Minor points noted only: the 30-day return clock runs from our request rather than from termination, and pricing is fixed to the expiring Order Form; neither is adverse to us, so no redline.
